_comment: Copy to <your project>/kit.config.json and edit. Paths are relative to the project root. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_taskPrompt: Empty = use the kit's protocol/TASK-PROMPT.md. Set a project file (e.g. PROMPT-NEXT-TASK.md) to override.
_dataDir: Runner logs, runs.jsonl, status.json, latest-summary.md. Must be gitignored.
_protectedPaths: Files task sessions must never commit. The runner stops the run if a task commit touches one.

claude._skipPermissions: true passes --dangerously-skip-permissions (unattended runs). Only use in a repo where the project rules forbid destructive actions.

hooks._dirtyPaths: If any of these has uncommitted changes, a task is mid-edit: restart is skipped.
hooks._restartCommand: Shell command (bash) that restarts/rebuilds the live app. Empty = no restart step.
hooks._checkCommand: Shell command (bash) printing a SHORT accuracy/health summary (counts only, no private data). Run by checkpoint.sh --check.
hooks._queueStatusCommand: Shell command printing one line of background-queue state. Used by checkpoint.sh and wait-until.sh.
hooks._queueBusyPattern: Extended regex: while the queue line matches this, the queue is busy.

gemini._blocked: Regexes (against the repo-relative path) the free Gemini helper refuses to send. Add every private folder.
